rows.originalValue: 5 axis Body Image Stabilization. Camera stabilizes up to 5.5 stops

rows.value: Automatic (Autofocus in modes iAF/AFs/AFc/Touch AF) or manual. With manual setting: Auto Magnification and Focus Peaking optionally available as focus aids

rows.label: 自动对焦系统
rows.value: Based on contrast metering and depth mapping

rows.label: 自动对焦模式
rows.value: Smart AF (autonomously selects AFs and AFc), AFs (picture taken only after successful focusing), AFc (picture can be taken at any time), AF setting can be saved

rows.label: 自动对焦测量方式
rows.value: Spot (can be shifted), Field (can be shifted), Multi-Field, Zone, Face detection, object Tracking, optional Touch AF

rows.value: Resolution: 5,760,000 点, 120 fps, magnification: 0.78x, aspect ratio: 4:3, frame coverage: 100%, exit pupil position: 21 mm, setting range +2/-4 diopters, with eye sensor for automatic switchover between viewfinder and LCD panel, time delay 0.005 s

rows.label: 液晶显示屏
rows.value: 3.2“ (backlight LED) with anti-fingerprint and anti-scratch coating, 2,100,000 像素 (点), format 3:2, touch control available

rows.label: 机顶显示屏
rows.value: 1.28“ highly reflective trans-reflective monochrome LCD, 128 x 128 像素, viewing angle 120°; anti-fingerprint coating

rows.label: 测光
rows.value: TTL (‚Through The Lens‘ exposure metering)

rows.label: 曝光模式
rows.value: Automatic program (P), Aperture priority (A): manual aperture setting, Shutter priority mode (S): manual shutter speed setting Manual (M): manual setting for shutter speed and aperture

rows.label: 曝光补偿
rows.value: ±3 EV in 1⁄3 EV increments or 1/2 EV increments

rows.label: ISO 范围
rows.value: Auto ISO: ISO 100 to ISO 50000, Manual: ISO 50 to ISO 50000

rows.label: 白平衡
rows.value: Automatic (Auto), Daylight 5200 K, Cloudy 6000 K, Shadow 7000 K, Tungsten 3200 K, HMI 5600 K, Fluorescent Warm 4000 K, Fluorescent Cold 4500 K, Flash 5400 K, Gray Card Live View, Gray Card, Color Temperature 2000 K to 11500 K

rows.value: Using center-weighted TTL pre-flash metering with Leica flash units (SF 26, 40, 58, 60, 64) or with system-compatible flash units, flash remote control SF C1

rows.value: SF 40: ±2 EV in 1⁄2 EV increments, SF 60: ±2 EV in 1⁄3 EV increments

rows.originalValue: Mech. shutter: 30 min to 1⁄8000 s / Electr. shutter function: 1 s to 1⁄40000 s / Flash Synch: up to 1/250 s

rows.originalValue: 3 or 5 exposures, up to ±3 EV, in 1⁄3 EV increments Shift function: up to ±3 EV

rows.value: About the accessory shoe

rows.value: : 1⁄250 s, slower shutter speeds available, automatic changeover to TTL linear flash mode with HSS-compatible Leica flash units if sync time is undercut

rows.label: 相机类型
rows.value: Mirrorless full-frame system camera
